ios.desc:
Discover the best bike routes anywhere in the world. Plan, navigate and record your rides with Bikemap — powered by millions of cycling routes from our global community.

Whether you’re commuting, exploring gravel roads or planning a multi-day cycling adventure, Bikemap helps you find the perfect route.

BIKE TRACKER & BIKE COMPUTER
Turn your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch into a bike computer. Includes HealthKit integration.

ROUTE PLANNER
Find the perfect routes in your area, tailored to your bike type.

TOUR PLANNER
Plan multi-day cycling adventures and organize your trip into stages.

LOOP PLANNER
Automatically generate round trips without manual route planning.

BIKEMAP.NET
If you want to plan in even more detail, you can also do so on bikemap.net and then sync your route with the app to start tracking and navigating immediately.

MILLIONS OF BIKE ROUTES
The most popular routes, MTB trails and cycle paths in your area and worldwide. Including official routes.

SURFACE AND WAYTYPE INFORMATION
See whether your route uses asphalt, gravel or trails before you start riding.

POIs
Find important places during your tours, such as toilets, restaurants, water points or e-bike charging stations. Avoid roadworks, potholes and slippery roads thanks to live community reports.

MONTHLY & ANNUAL RECAP
Relive your rides with monthly and annual cycling recaps — perfect for sharing with your friends.

INTEGRATIONS
Connect Bikemap with Garmin and Wahoo to send routes to your bike computer or sync recorded rides back to Bikemap.

-- NOW EVEN MORE FUNCTIONS WITH BIKEMAP PREMIUM --

TURN-BY-TURN NAVIGATION
Never miss a turn again and get voice navigation instructions for all routes.

SELF-GUIDED NAVIGATION
Follow your route based on your location. Perfect for off-road sections.

OFFLINE MAPS & ROUTES
Download maps and routes for offline use.

BIKE TYPE OPTIMIZED ROUTING
Optimize navigation for your road bike, mountain bike or city bike. Navigate preferably on cycle paths.

SPECIAL BIKE MAPS
Choose from 3D, Night, OpenCycleMap, OpenStreetMap, Satellite, Atlas, Outdoors and Landscape.

BATTERY SAVE MODE
Preserve battery life while you record or follow a route.

INDIVIDUAL BIKE COMPUTER
Activate the statistics you want to keep an eye on at all times.

DETAILED ROUTE PREVIEW
See your route in 3D at home - including elevation profile.

WEATHER FORECAST
Check the detailed weather by route and time, with wind graphs and 10-day outlooks.


The payment will be charged through your App

quotes.text:
Oh man, I'm in the same boat right now, working on changing that. "Pencil neck" teenager, now a flabby-tabby. Starting at 20% over ideal thanks to fork-to-mouth habits and a medication which increases hunger.

Got a fitbit and a bicycle, riding a 1-2 hours a day.

Using the free Bikemap app on iOS https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/bikemap-map-your-bike-route-with-gps-cycling/id625759466?mt=8

Just have to stay heart-rate/exertion-limited due to Marfan syndrome.

With age, it's good to increase care for rotator cuff, trapezius and shoulder muscles/ligaments unless one enjoys expensive/painful surgery to reattach separations.
